overview: Rights issues - human, women, SC/ST, child and other rights: 8 official questions (2010-2024), at most 2 per year. They are scheme or Act details (launch date, full form, beneficiaries) and, since 2023, statement-based items on the Protection of Human Rights Act as amended in 2019. Several older keys are unofficial.

possibility.what_they_ask: 2019 amendment: who can chair, term, re-appointment, number of members, limitation period, removal
aim of a scheme (Swayamsidha); survey findings on women; natural targets: NCW Act 1990, DV Act 2005, POSH 2013
Forest Rights Act dates; natural targets: PoA Act 1989, PESA 1996, Gram Sabha role
full form and amendment of POCSO; PM CARES for Children eligibility

possibility.angle: Other rights (trafficking, minorities, disabled, elderly, transgender)
possibility.what_they_ask: UNODC trafficking report finding; natural targets: RPwD Act 2016 (21 disabilities), Transgender Persons Act 2019

traps.trap: [Look-alike word] Acronym expanded with a near word
traps.spot: Options differing by one word (Sexual / Social)
traps.fix: POCSO = Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (2012)

traps.spot: Four consecutive dates for an Act
traps.fix: Forest Rights Act passed 18 Dec 2006; assent 29 Dec 2006; in force 31 Dec 2007

traps.trap: Amended rule treated as the old rule
traps.spot: NHRC statements on chair eligibility and term
traps.fix: After 2019: a former CJI or SC judge may chair; term 3 years or 70; re-appointment allowed
UNODC 2016: victims and traffickers often share the same ethnic/national background

techniques.name: Amendment-year lens
techniques.how: [Old vs amended] For any rights body, ask which version the stem uses; learn the post-amendment numbers (NHRC 2019).
techniques.example: PHRA 2019 changes: SC judge eligible, 3-year term, re-appointment → 'I, II and III' [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#54]

techniques.name: Beneficiary definition check
techniques.how: For schemes, read who is covered (age, cause, period) and match every clause.
techniques.example: PM CARES for Children: launched 29 May 2021, children who lost parents or guardians to Covid-19 → both statements true [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#46]

techniques.name: Word-by-word acronym
techniques.how: Expand acronyms word by word from the Act title; reject an option if one word differs.
techniques.example: Only 'Protection of Children from Sexual Offences' matches [group1-prelims-2019-paper2#109]

confusions.remember: individual/community forest rights vs self-rule in Fifth Schedule areas
sexual offences against children vs children in conflict with law and care

confusions.a: NHRC chair (former CJI or SC judge)
confusions.b: SHRC chair (former CJ or HC judge)
confusions.remember: appointed by President vs Governor; both removed by President
SHG empowerment vs training / women in difficult circumstances

anchors: Forest Rights Act: passed 18 Dec 2006, in force 31 Dec 2007
PHRA 1993, amended 2019: 3-year term, re-appointment, three expert members
NCW Act 1990, NCW set up January 1992
UNODC trafficking report 2016: victims and traffickers often same background
checklist: Which version of the Act - original or amended?
For dates, recall passed vs assent vs in-force.
Scheme question: check beneficiary, ministry and launch year.
Treat questions with unofficial keys as low-weight practice.
